name: rrt-2d-motion-planning

greedy_success_rate.description: Fraction of generated planning scenes solved by the greedy RRT variant.

conservative_success_rate.description: Fraction of generated planning scenes solved by the conservative RRT variant.

greedy_mean_iterations.description: Mean planner iterations across all generated scenes for the greedy RRT variant.

conservative_mean_iterations.description: Mean planner iterations across all generated scenes for the conservative RRT variant.

greedy_path_length_mutual.description: Mean path length on mutually solved scenes for the greedy RRT variant.

conservative_path_length_mutual.description: Mean path length on mutually solved scenes for the conservative RRT variant.

license: MIT for the planner code; scenes are procedurally generated (seeded), no external dataset.
citation: LaValle, S.M. (1998). Rapidly-exploring random trees: a new tool for path planning. TR 98-11.
seed_policy: RESEARCH_AGENT_SEED fixes scene+planner seeds; RESEARCH_AGENT_REPEAT_INDEX shifts the scene batch so repeats differ.
notes: 演示级（demonstration-grade）真实算法：真碰撞检测、真采样、种子可复现——不是占位常数。
但这是 2D toy 场景，不是 publication-grade benchmark；正式投稿须换 OMPL/MoveIt 等真实任务与公开数据。
比较条件：等迭代预算（max_iter=1500）。盲跑结论：greedy 在等预算下弱占优，'conservative 更鲁棒/greedy 路径更长'的假设被证伪，路径长度高密度无显著差异。
键名中性（greedy_*/conservative_*），不预设任一方为必胜 candidate。
